blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Patch-based learning improves hyperspectral image (HSI) classification by exploiting local spectral-spatial information, but random train-test sampling from the same image can cause spatial patch overlap, leading to data leakage and optimistic performance estimates. This paper investigates same-class train-test spatial overlap in patch-based HSI classification using two measures: overlap percentage ( O ​ P OP ), which quantifies the global amount of overlapped testing patch pixels, and average overlap ratio ( A ​ O ​ R AOR ), which measures the local severity among affected testing patches. Experiments on the Pavia University dataset compare random and non-random spatial sampling using SVM, MLP, 2D-CNN, 3D-CNN, ViT, and MorpMamba. The results show that deep patch-based models achieve high accuracy under random sampling, with 3D-CNN reaching 96.17% Overall Accuracy (OA), but drop substantially under non-random spatial sampling, where 3D-CNN decreases to 55.20% and ViT and 2D-CNN drop by 40.71 and 38.81 percentage points (PP), respectively. Patch-size analysis further shows that increasing the patch size from 5 × 5 5\times 5 to 19 × 19 19\times 19 raises the random-sampling overlap percentage from 23.28% to 77.02%. These findings demonstrate that random patch-based evaluation can substantially inflate classification performance, especially for models that strongly exploit spatial context. The code associated with this paper is available at: https://github.com/mqalkhatib/Data_Leakage_in_HSI_Classification .
blocks.zh: 基于补丁的学习通过利用本地光谱-空间信息来改进超光谱成像(HSI)的分类,但从同一张图像中随机的列车测试采样会导致空间补丁重叠,导致数据泄露和乐观的性能估计. 本文调查了基于补丁的HSI分类中的同等列车-测试空间重叠情况,采用两种衡量方法:重叠百分比(O P OP ),它量化了重复测试补丁像素的全球数量;平均重叠比率(A O R AOR ),它测量了受影响的测试补丁中的局部严重性. 帕维亚大学数据集上的实验利用SVM,MLP,2D-CNN,3D-CNN,ViT,和MorpMamba进行随机和非随机空间采样比较. 结果显示,以深补丁为基础的模型在随机采样下达到高精度,3D-CNN总精确度达到96.17%,但在非随机空间采样下大幅下降,3D-CNN下降至55.20%,而ViT和2D-CNN分别下降40.71和38.81个百分点. 补丁大小分析还表明,补丁大小由5×5 5\times 5增加到19×19 19\times 19将随机抽样重叠百分比从23.28%提高到77.02%. 这些调查结果表明,基于补丁的随机评价可大幅提升分类性能,特别是对于大力利用空间环境的模型而言。 与本文相关的代码见:https://github.com/mqalkhatib/Data_Leakage_in_HSI_Classification.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Hyperspectral image (HSI) classification assigns semantic labels to pixels using their spectral responses across many contiguous bands. Compared with Optical imagery, HSI captures richer material-specific information, which improves the discrimination of visually similar land-cover classes. This makes HSI classification important for fine-grained scene understanding, particularly when different materials exhibit similar spatial appearance but distinct spectral signatures. However, the task remains challenging due to high dimensionality, spectral redundancy, spatial variability within the same class, and the limited availability of labeled samples.
blocks.zh: 超光谱成像(HSI)分类将语义标签指定给像素使用其光谱响应,跨越许多相接波段. 与光学图像相比,HSI捕捉到更丰富的具体材料信息,这改善了视觉上相似的土地覆盖类的歧视. 这使得HSI的分类对于精细的场景理解很重要,特别是在不同的材料表现出相似的空间外观而不同的光谱特征时. 然而,由于维度高、光谱冗余、同一类别内的空间可变性以及标签样本有限,这项任务仍然具有挑战性。

blocks.en: Traditional methods, such as Support Vector Machines (SVMs) [ 12 ] and Multilayer Perceptrons (MLPs) [ 13 ] , have been widely used for HSI classification, but they often depend mainly on spectral features and have limited ability to exploit spatial context. Deep learning methods address this limitation by learning spectral-spatial representations directly from HSI data [ 4 ] . Convolutional neural network (CNN)-based models have progressed from spectral 1D-CNNs [ 9 ] to spatial 2D-CNNs [ 11 ] , joint spectral-spatial 3D-CNNs [ 8 ] , and hybrid 2D-3D CNNs [ 14 ] . More recently, transformer- and Mamba-based models have been introduced to capture long-range dependencies and improve spectral-spatial modeling [ 3 , 1 ] .
blocks.zh: 传统方法,如支持矢量机(SVMs)[12]和多层受体(MLP)[13]等,被广泛用于HSI分类,但它们往往主要依赖于光谱特征并具有有限的空间环境利用能力. 深层学习方法通过直接从HSI数据中学习光谱-空间表示[4]来解决这一局限性. 以革命神经网络(CNN)为基础的模型从光谱1D-CNNs [9] 发展到空间2D-CNNs [11] ,联合光谱-空间3D-CNNs [8],混合2D-3D CNNs [14]. 最近,采用了以变压器和曼巴为主的模型,以捕捉远距离依赖性,并改进光谱-空间模型[3, 1].

blocks.en: Despite these advances, many HSI classifiers still rely on patch-based learning, where a spatial neighborhood around each labeled pixel is used as input. Although this improves spectral-spatial representation, it can introduce data leakage when training and testing samples are randomly selected from the same image. In such cases, their patches may spatially overlap, causing shared pixels to appear in both sets, weakening train-test independence and producing overly optimistic performance estimates [ 7 , 15 ] . This leakage becomes more severe with larger patch sizes and higher training ratios, and is further amplified by spatial autocorrelation, where neighboring pixels often have similar spectra [ 15 ] . Although spatially disjoint sampling can reduce this issue [ 2 ] , it may further reduce the already limited number of labeled training samples.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这些进步,许多HSI分类器仍然依赖于基于补丁的学习,其中每个被标记像素周围的空间相邻被作为输入. 虽然这改善了光谱-空间代表,但当从同一图像中随机选择培训和测试样本时,它可以引入数据泄漏. 在这种情况下,它们的补丁可能会在空间上重叠,导致共享像素出现在两组中,削弱列车测试独立性并产生过于乐观的性能估计[7,15]. 这种渗出随着更大的补丁大小和更高的训练比而变得更加严重,被空间自相放大而进一步放大,相邻的像素经常有相近的光谱[15]. 虽然空间上不相连的采样可以减少这一问题[2],但可能进一步减少已经有限的有标签的训练样品。

blocks.en:
To better understand and quantify data leakage,
this paper investigates the relationship between same-class
train-test spatial overlap and classification performance across
six classifiers and two sampling protocols. Unlike prior studies
that mainly identify or mitigate leakage, this study jointly
quantifies its global extent and local severity using overlap
percentage and average overlap ratio. SVM, MLP, 2D-CNN,
3D-CNN, Vision Transformer (ViT), and MorpMamba are evaluated
under random and non-random spatial sampling to assess model
sensitivity and quantify the resulting accuracy inflation.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Patch-Based Learning in HSI
blocks.zh: 2.1 HSI的补丁学习

blocks.en:
Patch-based learning is widely used to incorporate spatial
context by extracting a local neighborhood around each labeled
pixel and using it as the model input. This strategy allows
classifiers to exploit local spectral-spatial correlations and has
become common in CNN, Transformer, and Mamba-based HSI
classification frameworks [ 11 , 8 , 14 , 3 , 1 ] .

However, patch extraction introduces dependencies between
samples from the same scene. Since neighboring patches may
share many pixels, training and testing samples can become
highly correlated even when their center pixels are different [ 7 , 15 ] .
This dependency is mainly controlled by the patch size and
sampling strategy. Larger patches increase spatial coverage and
therefore raise the probability of train-test overlap, while random
sampling from a single image can place training and testing pixels
close to each other due to spatial continuity [ 7 , 15 ] .

blocks.en: 2.2 Data Leakage in Remote Sensing and Computer Vision
blocks.zh: 2.2 国家 遥感和计算机远景数据泄漏

blocks.en:
Data leakage occurs when testing information becomes indirectly
available during training, leading to overly optimistic performance
estimates. In patch-based HSI classification, random sampling from
the same image may place training and testing samples in spatially
correlated regions, causing their patches to overlap and share pixels [ 7 , 15 ] . Spatially disjoint,
iterative, and augmentation-based sampling strategies have been
proposed to reduce this dependence [ 2 , 5 , 7 ] ,
but they may reduce the number of usable labeled samples and
primarily focus on mitigation.

同样的图像可以将培训和测试样本放在空间上
相关区域,导致其补丁相重叠并共享像素[7,15]. 空间脱节,
迭接和基于增强的取样战略
建议减少这种依赖性[2、5、7],

blocks.en:
Comparatively little attention has been given to
jointly quantifying the global extent and local severity of
same-class train-test patch overlap and relating these characteristics to performance degradation across different classifier families under matched experimental conditions. This work addresses this gap using two complementary overlap measures evaluated across traditional machine-learning, CNN-based, Transformer-based, and Mamba-based classifiers under random and leakage-reduced spatial sampling protocols.

blocks.en: 3.1 Patch-Based HSI Classification

blocks.en: 3.3 Non-Random Spatial Sampling Protocol
blocks.zh: 3.3 非随机空间取样议定书

blocks.en: To examine the effect of spatial overlap in patch-based HSI classification, two sampling protocols are considered, as illustrated in Fig. 2 . The first follows the conventional random strategy, where labeled pixels are divided into training, validation, and testing subsets. Since each pixel is represented by a spatial patch, nearby training and testing samples may share pixels, introducing spatial dependency and potentially inflating classification performance.
blocks.zh: 为审查基于补丁的HSI分类中空间重叠的影响,考虑了两个采样协议,如图所示. 2 (中文(简体) ). 第一种遵循常规的随机策略,将被标记的像素分为训练,验证,测试子集. 由于每个像素都以空间补丁为代表,附近的培训和测试样本可能共享像素,引入了空间依赖性,并有可能夸大分类性能.

blocks.en:
The second protocol uses non-random spatial sampling, where samples are selected with greater spatial separation. This reduces direct mixing between training and testing regions and provides a stricter evaluation setting. Since testing pixels are not explicitly excluded after patch extraction, this setting is considered leakage-reduced rather than fully leakage-free. Training samples are selected first. Validation
samples are then drawn from the remaining labeled pixels and
used only for model monitoring and selection, while all other
labeled pixels form the test set used for the final performance
evaluation.
blocks.zh:
第二协议采用非随机空间采样,其中选取样本时空间分取较大. 这减少了培训和测试地区之间的直接混合,提供了更严格的评价环境。 由于测试像素在补丁取出后没有被明确排除,因此这种设置被认为是减少渗出而不是完全无渗出. 培训样本首先选定。 验证
然后从所剩标签像素中取出样品,
仅用于模型监测和选择,所有其他
标签像素构成用于最终性能的测试集
评价。

blocks.en: Comparing the two protocols allows the sensitivity of each classifier to train-test spatial overlap to be evaluated. A large performance drop under non-random spatial sampling suggests that the model may have benefited from spatial dependency under random patch-based evaluation.
blocks.zh: 比较这两个协议,可以对每个分类器在测试空间重叠方面的敏感性进行评价。 在非随机空间采样下出现大量性能下降,表明该模型可能得益于随机补丁评价下的空间依赖.

blocks.en: The experiments are conducted on the Pavia University hyperspectral dataset, which contains nine labeled land-cover classes [ 10 ] . Before patch extraction, PCA is applied to reduce the spectral dimensionality to P = 15 P=15 components, and each labeled pixel is represented by a 9 × 9 × 15 9\times 9\times 15 spatial-spectral patch.
blocks.zh: 实验是在帕维亚大学的超光谱数据集上进行的,该数据集包含有9个有标签的土地覆盖类[10]. 补丁取出之前,应用了PCA来将光谱维度降低为P=15 P=15个元件,每个被标记的像素由9×9×15 9\times 9\times 15个空间-光谱补丁来代表.

blocks.en: For both sampling protocols, a class-balanced training set is constructed by selecting 94 samples per class, corresponding to approximately one-tenth of the smallest class, Shadow, which contains 947 labeled samples. In addition, 18 samples per class are used for validation and reserved only for model monitoring and selection, while all remaining labeled pixels are used for testing.
blocks.zh: 对于两个采样规程,通过每班选取94个样品来构建一个班级平衡训练集,相当于最小的班级"影子"(Shadow)的大约十分之一,包含有947个标注的样品. 此外,每类有18个样本用于验证,并仅保留用于模型监测和选择,而其余所有被标记的像素则用于测试.

blocks.en: The evaluated classifiers include SVM [ 12 ] , MLP [ 13 ] , 2D-CNN [ 11 ] , 3D-CNN [ 8 ] , ViT [ 6 ] , and MorpMamba [ 1 ] . The same training configuration is used under both sampling protocols so that performance differences are mainly attributed to the sampling strategy. All experiments are repeated over 10 independent runs, and the results are reported as mean ± \pm standard deviation using Overall Accuracy (OA), Average Accuracy (AA), Kappa coefficient, and class-wise accuracy.
blocks.zh: 评估的分类包括SVM [12],MLP [13],2D-CNN [11],3D-CNN [8],Vit [6],和Morpmanba. [一]. 两项取样规程都采用了同样的训练配置,以便业绩差异主要归因于取样战略。 所有实验都重复了超过10个独立运行,结果被报告为使用总体精确度(OA),平均精确度(AA),Kappa系数和分级精确度的平均值±\pm标准偏差.

blocks.en: 4 Results and Discussion
blocks.zh: 4 结果和讨论

blocks.en:
Tables 1 and 2 present the
classification results under random and non-random patch-based
sampling, respectively. Under random sampling, deep spectral-spatial models clearly outperform traditional classifiers. The 3D-CNN achieves the highest OA of 96.17%, followed by ViT, 2D-CNN, and MorpMamba with 91.78%, 86.97%, and 81.07%, respectively,
whereas SVM and MLP obtain 62.15% and 69.50%. A similar trend
is observed for AA and Kappa, indicating that deep patch-based
models benefit strongly when training and testing samples are
randomly distributed within the same image.

随机和非随机补丁分类结果
分别取样。 在随机抽样下,深光谱-空间模型明显优于传统分类器。 3D-CNN实现最高的OA为96.17%,其次是ViT,2D-CNN和Morpmanba,分别为91.78%,86.97%和81.07%,
SVM和MLP获得62.15%和69.50%。 类似趋势
观测到AA和Kappa,表明深补丁

blocks.en: This advantage decreases substantially under the non-random spatial setting. As summarized in Table 3 , all models experience an OA reduction, with the largest drops observed for 3D-CNN, ViT, and 2D-CNN at 40.97, 40.71, and 38.81 percentage points, respectively. MorpMamba decreases by 32.62 percentage points, while SVM and MLP show smaller drops of 10.90 and 19.35 percentage points. These results indicate that models explicitly exploiting spatial neighborhoods are more sensitive to the sampling protocol.
blocks.zh: 在非随机空间环境下,这一优势被大大削弱。 如表3所概述,所有模型的OA减少,3D-CNN、VIT和2D-CNN的下降幅度最大,分别为40.97分、40.71分和38.81分。 MorpMamba下降了32.62个百分点,而SVM和MLP的下降幅度较小,分别为10.90和19.35个百分点. 这些结果表明,明确利用空间街区的模型对取样协议更为敏感.

blocks.en: The class-wise results show a similar pattern. For 3D-CNN, accuracy decreases from 94.28% to 46.27% for Asphalt, from 97.63% to 49.78% for Meadows, from 91.59% to 43.99% for Gravel, and from 96.38% to 47.89% for Bare Soil. These large reductions mainly occur in spatially variable classes. In contrast, compact and spectrally distinctive classes, such as Metal Sheet and Shadow, remain comparatively easier to classify under non-random sampling.
blocks.zh: 分级的结果表明类似模式。 3D-CNN的精度从94.28%下降到46.27%,草地的精度从97.63%下降到49.78%,Gravel的精度从91.59%下降到43.99%,裸出土壤的精度从96.38%下降到47.89%. 这些大幅削减主要发生在空间可变类别. 相比之下,金属板和阴影等紧凑和有光谱特征的分类,在非随机抽样下分类相对容易。

blocks.en:
Overall, Tables 1 and 2 indicate that the
high accuracy obtained under random patch-based evaluation is partly influenced by same-class train-test spatial dependency. Neighboring patches may share pixels or highly similar local structures, allowing information from training regions to be indirectly reflected in the test set. Random sampling may therefore produce optimistic performance estimates, whereas non-random spatial sampling provides a stricter assessment of model generalization.
blocks.zh:
总的来说,表1和表2表明,
根据随机补丁评估获得的高精度部分受同级列车测试空间依赖性所影响. 相邻的补丁可能共享像素或高度相近的局部结构,使得来自训练区的信息能被间接地反映在测试集中. 因此,随机采样可能会产生乐观的性能估计,而非随机空间采样则能更严格地评估模型通俗化.

blocks.en: Table 3 : Overall accuracy degradation, in percentage points, from random sampling to non-random spatial sampling.
blocks.zh: 表3:从随机取样到非随机空间取样的总体准确度退化,以百分点计。

blocks.en: 4.1 Effect of Patch Size on Same-Class Spatial Leakage
blocks.zh: 4.1 补丁大小对同级空间泄漏的影响

blocks.en: Table 4 shows the effect of patch size on the same-class O ​ P OP and A ​ O ​ R AOR , computed using Eqs. ( 2 ) and ( 4 ), respectively. Under random sampling, O ​ P OP increases from 23.28% with a 5 × 5 5\times 5 patch to 77.02% with a 19 × 19 19\times 19 patch, showing that larger patches substantially increase the portion of testing regions covered by training patches. A ​ O ​ R AOR follows the same trend, increasing from 47.29% to 79.91%, which indicates that larger patches also increase the severity of overlap among the affected testing patches.
blocks.zh: 表4显示补丁大小对同级O P OP和A R AOR的影响,分别使用Eqs(2)和(4)计算。 在随机采样下,OP OP从23.28%用5×5 5.\times 5补丁增加到77.02%用19×19 19.\times 19补丁,显示较大的补丁会大大增加被训练补丁所覆盖的测试区域的比例. 一个O R AOR也遵循同样的趋势,从47.29%上升到79.91%,这表明较大的补丁也使受影响的测试补丁之间的重叠更严重.

blocks.en: Table 4 : Effect of patch size on same-class overlap percentage and average overlap ratio under random and non-random spatial sampling settings. The values are computed from the training and testing patch locations, not from model predictions. Only mean values are reported.
blocks.zh: 表4:在随机和非随机空间采样设置下补丁大小对同级重叠百分比和平均重叠比率的影响. 数值是根据培训和测试补丁地点计算的,而不是根据模型预测。 只报告平均值。

blocks.en: In contrast, the non-random spatial setting maintains a much lower overlap percentage, increasing only from 0.83% to 4.66% as the patch size grows from 5 × 5 5\times 5 to 19 × 19 19\times 19 . This confirms that the non-random sampling strategy greatly reduces the global amount of same-class train-test overlap. However, A ​ O ​ R AOR remains relatively high, decreasing from 45.26% to around 39% for larger patch sizes. This is because Eq. ( 4 ) is computed only over testing patches with non-zero overlap; thus, although few testing patches are affected, the remaining overlap cases may still contain considerable local overlap.
blocks.zh: 相形之下,非随机空间设置保持了更低的重叠百分比,随着补丁大小从5×5 5\时增长到19×19 19\时增长到4.66%. 这证实了非随机采样策略会大大减少同等级列车测试重叠的全球数量. 然而,AO R AOR仍然相对较高,较大补丁尺寸从45.26%下降到了约39%. 这是因为Eq. (4 )只通过非零相重叠的测试补丁进行计算;因此,尽管测试补丁受到影响的不多,但所剩的重叠情况可能仍然含有相当的局部相重叠.

blocks.en: Overall, patch size directly controls both the extent and severity of spatial leakage. O ​ P OP measures the global amount of leakage, whereas A ​ O ​ R AOR provides complementary information about the severity of the affected cases. This distinction is important in leakage-reduced settings, where the number of affected testing patches may be small even when their local overlap remains high.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,补丁大小直接控制了空间泄漏的程度和严重性. OP OP衡量全球渗漏量,而AO R AOR则提供关于受影响病例严重程度的补充信息。 这种区分在减少渗漏的环境下很重要,在这种情况下,受影响的测试补丁数量可能很小,即使其局部重叠程度仍然很高。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: This paper investigated same-class train-test spatial overlap in patch-based hyperspectral image classification using two measures: O ​ P OP and A ​ O ​ R AOR . The results showed that random patch-based sampling can substantially inflate classification performance, especially for deep models that exploit spatial context. Under non-random spatial sampling, 3D-CNN, ViT, and 2D-CNN showed large OA drops of 40.97, 40.71, and 38.81 percentage points, respectively, while SVM and MLP showed smaller reductions. The patch-size analysis further confirmed that larger patches increase spatial leakage, with the random-sampling overlap percentage rising from 23.28% for 5 × 5 5\times 5 patches to 77.02% for 19 × 19 19\times 19 patches.
blocks.zh: 本文利用O P OP和A O R AOR两种措施,调查了同级列车在补丁基超光谱图像分类中的空间测试重叠情况。 结果显示,以随机补丁为基础的取样可以大大地提高分类性能,特别是利用空间背景的深层模型。 在非随机空间采样下,3D-CNN,VIT和2D-CNN的OA降幅分别为40.97分,40.71分和38.81分,而SVM和MLP的降幅较小. 补丁尺寸分析还进一步证实,较大的补丁会增加空间渗漏,随机抽样的重叠百分比从5×5 5\时的23.28%上升到19×19 19\时的77.02%.

blocks.en: Future work will extend this analysis to additional hyperspectral datasets and different training ratios to further assess the generality of the observed leakage effects. More rigorous spatial separation strategies will also be investigated to reduce train-test dependency while preserving sufficient labeled samples for training. In addition, future studies may examine how leakage affects newer deep architectures and whether model design choices can improve robustness under leakage-reduced evaluation settings.
blocks.zh: 今后的工作将把这一分析扩大到额外的超光谱数据集和不同的培训比率,以进一步评估所观察到的渗漏效应的普遍性。 还将调查更严格的空间分离战略,以减少对火车测试的依赖,同时保留足够的标有标签的样品供培训之用。 此外,今后的研究可以研究渗漏如何影响更新的深层建筑,以及模型设计选择是否能够在减少渗漏的评价环境中提高稳健性。
